title: bureau-pipeline: turn on the Alarm Repair — set the repository variable ALARM_REPAIR_LIVE to true

excerpts.text: In bureau-pipeline's repository settings, under Actions variables, set `ALARM_REPAIR_LIVE` to `true`, in the operator's name.
To turn the repair off again, set the variable to anything else.

title: bureau-pipeline: delete the PLANNER_MAX_RUNNING repo variable from agent-bureau, bureau-pipeline, portico and agent-bureau-demo, and release any card the groom queue left in Intake (operator)

excerpts.text: For each of `dreadnought-foundry/agent-bureau`, `dreadnought-foundry/bureau-pipeline`, `dreadnought-foundry/portico` and `dreadnought-foundry/agent-bureau-demo`: `gh variable delete PLANNER_MAX_RUNNING -R <owner/repo>`.
`gh variable list -R <owner/repo>` for the four above and for `dreadnought-foundry/foundry`, `dreadnought-foundry/onboard-sandbox-5`, `EveryBite/atlas` and `DeltaSolv/deltasolv`.
`python3 scripts/proof_release.py check --repo dreadnought-foundry/agent-bureau --merge DRE-8620:<pr>:<merge sha>` prints `proof-release: ready` — the console release carrying DRE-8620 is live.

title: agent-bureau: the operator opens one canary pull request adding a copy of Notice, so the proof can watch the duplicate check go red

excerpts.text: One draft pull request titled `canary: parts check — do not merge` was opened in agent-bureau from the branch `agent/parts-check-canary`, after the stub merged, adding one local `function Notice` outside the components folders and nothing else.

If no Merge Gate run has started 15 minutes after the last workflow run on the head completed, start one with `gh workflow run merge-gate.yml --repo dreadnought-foundry/agent-bureau -f pr_number=<n>` and say so in the comment below.
Close the pull request unmerged and delete the branch, then comment on this card: the pull request number, its head sha, and the Merge Gate run's id.

title: agent-bureau: archive the Linear project and Initiative of retired onboard-sandbox

excerpts.text: The Linear project `onboard-sandbox: Onboard Sandbox` — put it in a terminal state and archive it.
Any Initiative for Onboard Sandbox — put it in Completed and archive it.
The onboarding process creates none, so there may be nothing to do.

title: agent-bureau: archive the Linear project and Initiative of retired onboard-sandbox-4

excerpts.text: The Linear project `onboard-sandbox-4: Onboard Sandbox 4` — put it in a terminal state and archive it.
Any Initiative for Onboard Sandbox 4 — put it in Completed and archive it.

title: bureau-pipeline: the operator opens one throwaway pull request that breaks the verify step, sees the replay gate hold it, and closes it unmerged

excerpts.text: From `main`, open one draft pull request on a branch named `operator/replay-gate-negative-control`.
So such a case is expected on `main` after the first Sunday's pull request merges, whether or not any recorded removal passes yet.
Close the pull request unmerged, and delete the branch.

title: OPERATOR: set NO_RECORD_RETURN_MODE=enforce on the live relay, then close this card through the console's Record the outcome

excerpts.text: Turn the relay's no-record return on, live.
The code ships behind `NO_RECORD_RETURN_MODE`, which defaults to `off`, and only the bootstrap deploy sets a relay environment variable — it needs the operator's AWS profile, which no agent holds.
Then close THIS card through the console's **Record the outcome**, with a one-sentence outcome saying what was set and when.
